name: @chulf58/sterling
description: Sterling monorepo — plugin sources. The shipped plugin is described in STERLING-SPEC.md section 2.2.

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/schemas/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/store/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/mcp-server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/tui/tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-stamp.mjs
scripts.build:bundles: node scripts/build-hooks.mjs && node scripts/build-tui.mjs && node scripts/build-mcp.mjs && node scripts/build-bin.mjs && node scripts/build-opencode.mjs && node scripts/build-opencode-tui.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/check-agent-registry.mjs && node scripts/check-spawn-contracts.mjs && node scripts/check-agent-prompts.mjs && node scripts/check-tool-grants.mjs && node scripts/check-skills.mjs && node scripts/check-bundles-fresh.mjs && node scripts/check-record-citations.mjs && node scripts/check-projection-fresh.mjs && node scripts/check-stale-claims.mjs --base main && node scripts/check-record-hygiene.mjs
